purpose: Response-blind feasibility census for a within-Lepidoptera trait-conditioned transfer study.
major_complete: wing size + voltinism + NumberOfHostplantFamilies + CanopyAffinity + EdgeAffinity + MoistureAffinity + DisturbanceAffinity
panel_split: Within each trait stage, rank species by SHA256(lepidoptera-trait-transfer-v0.1|stage|species); lower half train, upper half evaluation.
interpretation: The census selects no transfer estimator and opens no synthetic or empirical response. If coverage is insufficient, decide prospectively among moth-trait augmentation, marker expansion, or a different estimator before response analysis.
